priorityList: Use Charge to engage the target or if you are out of melee range.
Use Pummel to interrupt enemy spellcasting.
Cast Recklessness and Avatar together as your primary offensive cooldowns.
Cast Rampage if Enrage is about to expire or if you have 100 or more Rage.
Cast Thunder Blast if you have 2 stacks of the Thunder Blast buff.
Cast Bloodbath whenever it is available.
Cast Rampage while Recklessness is active to dump Rage.
Cast Thunder Blast while Avatar is active.
Cast Execute whenever it is available.
Cast Crushing Blow whenever it is available.
Cast Thunder Blast to consume any remaining procs.
Cast Rampage as your primary Rage spender.
Use Raging Blow, Thunder Clap, or Whirlwind as fillers if nothing else is available.
